summary: When the companion thread dies during start (open_port, store, service.start or bridge bind fails), the profile OS lock and the process-wide _owner stay held until an explicit close()/unload.
failure_scenario: Gateway process starts companion; _main acquires profile lock (self._profile_lock set), then service.start() raises ArchiveRefusal('incompatible') or the bridge cannot bind its port; _run suppresses the error and the thread ends, but unlock_run_record and _owner reset happen only in close(). Until Hermes calls on_unload (typically process exit) another Hermes process (CLI/cron/gateway) cannot take the profile lock despite the module docstring promising hand-off, and a later start in this process is refused as 'multiplexed'.
evidence: Source trace: _main sets self._profile_lock before open_port; its finally clears only _ready/_service; unlock and `_owner = None` are only in close(); hermes_plugin._close_companion is the sole caller, registered via on_unload. Not run; no runtime reproduction.

summary: complete() allocates a transport sequence before validating the terminal status, so an invalid status burns a sequence number and raises.
failure_scenario: complete(run_id, status='bogus') -> sequencer.next() increments _last_sequence, then WorkTerminalStatus('bogus') raises ValueError; no event is stored, so a later valid completion for the run is emitted with a gap in the sequence stream.
evidence: Source: EventSequencer.next mutates _last_sequence under its lock (sequencing.py:21-27); WorkTerminalStatus(status) is evaluated after it inside the WorkCompletedEvent construction. Callers may validate status earlier; not checked or run.

summary: RollingRouteMetrics bounds samples per key but not the number of (route, backend) keys.
failure_scenario: Any caller feeding many distinct valid labels (up to 64 chars each) grows _samples without limit, each key holding a deque up to capacity.
evidence: Source: observe() validates label shape only, then self._samples[key] on a defaultdict. No caller-side cardinality bound was traced.

summary: network_origin.canonical_remote_hostname run on CPython 3.11 and 3.13: 127.1, 0x7f.1, 0177.0.0.1, 2130706433, ::ffff:127.0.0.1, ::ffff:7f00:1, 0.0.0.0 and trailing-dot localhost are all refused. No defect found.

HermesCompletionRouter: expiration callback takes service._dispatch_lock while holding the router lock, but service never calls the router, so no lock-order cycle. Eviction pairs acknowledgment pop with retry-cache expiry and bridge can_track/track run under the registration lock.
host._wait_for_profile_lock abandon/handoff race (stop vs acquire) releases the descriptor on every ordering reviewed.
